main_issue: Who will cover Agent D's unfinished analysis section for Thursday's pitch while D is away for a family funeral

A-B.evidence: B rejects A's 'we' (T4, T6), says looking won't change workload (T14); A keeps pushing, then offers to do the analysis herself (T15), which B does not endorse.

A-C.evidence: C refuses extra work (T7, T12), but after A's offer to take the analysis (T15) C says 'We can look' (T16); both then go through D's section (T28-30).

A-D.evidence: A tells D not to worry and the team will cover it (T3); D offers a walkthrough (T17) and A accepts 'huge help' (T18), then engages with D's explanation (T28-30).

B-C.evidence: C says 'He's right' about not being able to take more on (T7); both resist A's plan, though C later agrees to look (T16) while B stays firm (T14).

B-D.evidence: B never addresses D, and D never speaks to B or about B's position; B only objects to A's plan to cover D's section.

C-D.evidence: C says she cannot do D's analysis (T12); D's walkthrough (T17, T27-29) is for all, and C only agrees to look (T16), with no direct exchange.
